components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call to action across app routes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.922 0 0)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.922 0 0 / 90%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0 / 50%); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions in toolbars and cards.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 15%); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 30%); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 6%); transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.371 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0 / 50%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 15%); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 30%); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 6%); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.708 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.556 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0 / 50%); }

narrative.overview: Playblast looks and feels like a dim, focused review room on a studio LAN: dark surfaces, crisp type, and color reserved for status, markers, and the single warm annotation accent. The UI recedes so video stays sovereign.
keyCharacteristics: Video-first layout with collapsible chrome and focus mode
OKLCH semantic tokens with tonal surfaces
Restrained accent usage; status colors carry workflow meaning
shadcn/ui primitives with Playblast utility classes
Mono timestamps in the player HUD

rules.name: The Video Sovereignty Rule
rules.body: On deliverable and compare routes, non-player chrome must be collapsible or secondary.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Color encodes state (status, role, marker, destructive). Decorative gradients and accent flooding are out of scope.

rules.name: The Timecode Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything tied to playback position or duration uses the mono timestamp style.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear on cards and overlays, not on every list row.

dos: Do default to dark theme for review surfaces and preserve focus mode on deliverable routes.
Do use semantic tokens instead of raw hex in components.
Do use PageLoading, EmptyState, and PageError for cataloged UI states.
donts: Don't place CRM/finance data on proofing-only routes.
Don't use decorative color outside status, markers, annotations, and the sidebar accent.
Don't hide authorization by disabling controls alone.
